The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is located in the northern part of the [[Wheat Farm]]. When you first arrive the mill is broken and needs to be repaired. After repaired, the [[Miller]] will allow you to use it to mill wheat for free. The Mill is more efficient than the [[Cooking#Cooking Table|cooking table]] as it can be used to instantly turn {{Item|wheat|10}} into {{Item|flour|15}}.
